stem: A 35-year-old day laborer is being evaluated for TB preventive treatment after his brother, with whom he shares a household, was diagnosed with fluoroquinolone-susceptible MDR-TB two months ago and remains on treatment. He has no significant past medical history. He was vaccinated with BCG as a child. Active TB disease has been ruled out in him through symptom screening and chest imaging. No HIV risk factors. Exam: well-appearing, no acute findings.

patient.social_history: Shares a household with his brother, diagnosed with MDR-TB two months ago
patient.presenting_complaint: Household contact evaluation for TB preventive treatment; active TB already ruled out
patient.prior_treatment: None; no prior TB treatment ever

distractors: His lack of any current symptoms taken as sufficient reassurance without considering preventive treatment given his documented exposure
His BCG vaccination history proposed as a reason to avoid tuberculin skin testing altogether
ntep_correct_actions: Offer this contact a fixed, standardized preventive regimen of 6 months of daily levofloxacin as a routine part of programmatic TB preventive treatment for a household contact of fluoroquinolone-susceptible MDR-TB, once active TB disease is excluded in him.
Treat TST and IGRA as interchangeable options for testing this contact for TB infection; his history of BCG vaccination should not be a determining factor in which test is chosen.
who_correct_actions: Offer this contact a fixed, standardized preventive regimen of 6 months of daily levofloxacin as a routine part of programmatic TB preventive treatment for a household contact of fluoroquinolone-susceptible MDR-TB, once active TB disease is excluded in him.
Treat TST and IGRA as interchangeable options for testing this contact for TB infection; his history of BCG vaccination should not be a determining factor in which test is chosen.
us_correct_actions: Treat offering preventive treatment to this contact as only conditionally appropriate versus observation alone; if treatment is given, individualize the regimen and duration to the source case's (his brother's) susceptibility pattern rather than using a fixed levofloxacin regimen.
Recommend IGRA specifically rather than TST for this contact, given his history of BCG vaccination, since BCG vaccination is understood to confound TST interpretation in this framework.
critical_error_conditions: Concluding that observation alone, without any preventive treatment, is an acceptable default for this contact of a confirmed MDR-TB case
expected_divergence_points: Whether household contacts of fluoroquinolone-susceptible MDR-TB receive a fixed, standardized preventive regimen or an individualized regimen contingent on a conditional decision to treat
Whether TST and IGRA are treated as interchangeable regardless of BCG vaccination history or IGRA is specifically preferred for BCG-vaccinated individuals
